domains.result: The website field on the Google profile is ajuliaexecutivesearch.com. https://www.ajuliaexecutivesearch.com/ and https://ajuliaexecutivesearch.com/ both redirect to https://www.airbase1.com/, an aviation website-design agency, which renders its own 'Fuel Your Aviation Marketing' homepage with no Ajulia content; an old Ajulia path (/specialized-search-and-placement/) lands on that same homepage. Over plain HTTP the domain returns a short HTML page that refreshes to /cgi-sys/defaultwebpage.cgi, a cPanel 'Default Web Site Page' placeholder reading 'SORRY!'. No certificate warning on this domain. Seen at 1440 px and at 390 px.

Chrome stops with net::ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID ('Your connection is not private'); the expanded detail reads that the server could not prove it is jobs.ajuliaexecutivesearch.com and that its security certificate is from airbase1.com. rdap.registrar: GoDaddy.com, LLC (IANA ID 146); registrant details redacted in RDAP

likely_cause.reasoning: Two candidate explanations, and the public record does not separate them. (1) The domain changed hands or was re-pointed at a new host: the firm's own WordPress site was captured as recently as 19 April 2025 (homepage) and 14 May 2025 (many subpages), no capture of the main site exists after 14 May 2025, the jobs board was still serving job pages on 17 June 2025, and today both the apex and www serve Airbase1's site while jobs.ajuliaexecutivesearch.com presents a certificate issued to airbase1.com and fails its name check. (2) It is still the firm's domain and only the hosting changed: RDAP shows one continuous record created in 2012, still held under client delete/renew/transfer/update locks, with DNS at Cloudflare (kara and rory.ns.cloudflare.com) and expiry extended to 14 June 2029 with a last-changed date of 16 June 2026 - changes consistent with a renewal or a DNS edit rather than a transfer, which would normally reset the creation date. Apex and www resolve to Cloudflare addresses (172.64.80.1 for the apex, 172.67.213.38 / 104.21.45.105 for www), so what is served on those names is decided in the Cloudflare configuration, while plain HTTP on the apex returns a cPanel 'Default Web Site Page', which points at a hosting account with no site configured for that name. Registrant contact is redacted, so who holds the domain cannot be seen from outside; we are not accusing any party. Labelled an inference.

fix_steps.step: Open the GoDaddy account that holds ajuliaexecutivesearch.com and confirm who controls it, that the contact email is one the firm still reads, and that registration stays paid to 14 June 2029. Note the 16 June 2026 change date in the registrar's history.
fix_steps.who: Owner or office manager, with whoever handled the website

fix_steps.step: Open the Cloudflare account that holds the domain's DNS (nameservers kara.ns.cloudflare.com and rory.ns.cloudflare.com) and read the records for www, @ and jobs: where each points and when each last changed. The apex currently answers with a Cloudflare address, www with Cloudflare addresses, and jobs with 69.167.165.235, so this shows whether the names were repointed.
fix_steps.who: Whoever holds the DNS login, or the firm's web person

fix_steps.step: Decide based on those two logins: if the domain is no longer the firm's, stop linking to it everywhere and register a new domain; if it is still the firm's, remove the record that sends www to the Airbase1 site, point www at a host the firm controls, restore content from the April-May 2025 archive captures, and re-issue a certificate for jobs.ajuliaexecutivesearch.com.
fix_steps.who: Owner decides; web person or hosting provider executes

fix_steps.step: Claim the Google Business Profile and complete it: one website link, hours, photos, services, and a single address and phone. The profile today says 'Claim this business', has no hours or photos, shows 2.5 stars and gives 2 King Arthur Ct #10, North Brunswick Township. Two directories instead give 1440 How Lane, Suite 2E, New Brunswick (https://www.clearlyrated.com/staffing/nj-usa/new-brunswick-nj/ajulia-executive-search-new-brunswick-nj and https://reviews.birdeye.com/ajulia-executive-search-154981789494430), and the labor department's notice lists 51 West Prospect Street, Suite 204, East Brunswick for 'Ajulia Executive Payroll L.L.C.', a different legal name that appears to be an affiliated entity (our inference, not confirmed by any source). The owner should settle which address customers should use.

Update or remove the website link on every other public profile that points at the domain: the Google listing, ClearlyRated ('Visit Their Website'), Birdeye and LeadIQ, and set the same single link on all of them.
fix_steps.who: Owner or office manager, or whoever holds the directory logins

fix_steps.step: Publish a small site on the working domain: home, services for employers, current open roles, and a contact page with tap-to-call and a form. Pages archived in April-May 2025 can be reused as a starting point.

Add basic monitoring: uptime and broken-link checks on the website and job board, auto-renew on a card that does not expire, two-factor login on both the registrar and DNS accounts, and a quarterly check of address and phone on the Google profile and main directories.
fix_steps.who: Web person sets it up; owner holds the logins

after_fix.opportunity: Claim the Google Business Profile and complete it - hours, photos, services and a working website link - so candidates and employers can find and call the firm directly.
after_fix.evidence: The live listing shows 'Claim this business', 'Add hours' and 'Add a photo', no photos, a 2.5 average and a website link that leaves the business entirely; the ClearlyRated and Birdeye profiles are also unclaimed ('Claim Your Profile' and 'This profile has not been claimed').

severity_reason: The website link on the firm's Google profile redirects to an unrelated aviation web-design agency, the same domain is linked from three further public profiles (ClearlyRated, Birdeye, LeadIQ), and the old job board subdomain throws a certificate warning, so we found no live page that tells a candidate or an employer what Ajulia does or how to reach it. The domain itself is still registered and paid to 2029, so the situation is fixable, but the business is not represented online today.
audit_md:
# Website Health Check: Ajulia Executive Search

**What we saw on 13 November 2026**
- The website link on the Google listing, ajuliaexecutivesearch.com, redirects to https://www.airbase1.com/, an aviation web-design agency, at desktop and phone width; old Ajulia paths land there too.
- The domain over plain HTTP shows a hosting "Default Web Site Page". The job board at jobs.ajuliaexecutivesearch.com stops with a Chrome warning: its certificate is issued to airbase1.com and fails the name check.
- The domain record is current: registered 2012, paid to 14 June 2029, last changed 16 June 2026, GoDaddy, DNS at Cloudflare.
- Four public pages still link to it: Google, ClearlyRated, Birdeye and LeadIQ. The Google profile says "Claim this business" and has no hours or photos.

**What it means for customers**
A customer who clicks the website link reaches another company's sales page instead of Ajulia, and the old job board is blocked by a browser warning. We found no working page explaining what Ajulia does or how to reach a recruiter.

**How to fix it**
1. Sign in to GoDaddy and Cloudflare; confirm who controls the domain and where www, @ and jobs point (1-4 h).
2. If the domain is not yours, take the link down and move to a new one; if it is, repoint www and re-issue the jobs certificate (2-6 h).
3. Update the website link on Google, ClearlyRated, Birdeye and LeadIQ, claim the profile, and settle which address is current (1-2 h).
4. Publish a small site with services, open roles and tap-to-call, reusing the archived 2025 pages (8-20 h).

**After the fix**
A claimed profile with hours, photos and a working link; today the listing has neither and shows 2.5 stars.

Prepared from publicly available information on 13 November 2026. We did not log in to or change anything.
